tools.name: search_docs
tools.description: Search Sorted Travel developer documentation for API, MCP, SDK, auth, and integration questions. Returns ranked excerpts with public URLs. Use this for how-to and reference questions. Do not use this tool to rank destinations or check visas — call the product MCP instead.

tools.name: get_doc_page
tools.description: Load one Sorted Travel documentation page as markdown. Pass a path from search_docs or list_doc_pages such as overview, mcp, rest-api, sdks, or auth.

tools.name: list_doc_pages
tools.description: List documentation pages on this docs MCP server, with path, title, description, and public URL. Pass query to filter by keyword; omit it to list every page.
